name: ExperienceReward.NoSkill
label: XP reward (no skill)
meaning: Experience given for crafting this with no skill.

name: ExperienceReward.Basic
label: XP reward (basic)
meaning: Experience given for crafting this at Basic skill.

name: ExperienceReward.Medium
label: XP reward (medium)
meaning: Experience given for crafting this at Medium skill.

name: ExperienceReward.Advanced
label: XP reward (advanced)
meaning: Experience given for crafting this at Advanced skill.

name: ExperienceReward.AboveAdvanced
label: XP reward (above advanced)
meaning: Experience given for crafting this above Advanced skill.

name: ProductQuantity
label: Amount produced
meaning: How many the recipe makes.

name: Ingredients
label: Ingredients
meaning: The ingredient slots the recipe needs.

name: Product
label: Produces
meaning: A link to what the recipe makes.

name: RelevantSkill
label: Skill
meaning: A link to the skill the recipe uses.

name: Duration.NoSkill
label: Craft time (no skill)
meaning: How long this recipe takes to craft with no skill.

name: Duration.Basic
label: Craft time (basic)
meaning: Craft time at Basic skill.

name: Duration.Medium
label: Craft time (medium)
meaning: Craft time at Medium skill.

name: Duration.Advanced
label: Craft time (advanced)
meaning: Craft time at Advanced skill.

name: Duration.AboveAdvanced
label: Craft time (above advanced)
meaning: Craft time above Advanced skill.

name: FamePointReward.NoSkill
label: Fame reward (no skill)
meaning: Fame given for crafting this with no skill.

name: FamePointReward.Basic
label: Fame reward (basic)
meaning: Fame given at Basic skill.

name: FamePointReward.Medium
label: Fame reward (medium)
meaning: Fame given at Medium skill.

name: FamePointReward.Advanced
label: Fame reward (advanced)
meaning: Fame given at Advanced skill.

name: FamePointReward.AboveAdvanced
label: Fame reward (above advanced)
meaning: Fame given above Advanced skill.

name: DisplayPriority
label: Menu order
meaning: Where this recipe sits in the crafting menu (lower comes first).

name: CanPlaceOnWater
label: Place on water
meaning: Whether the finished object may be placed on water.

name: CanPlaceOverItems
label: Place over items
meaning: Whether it may be placed overlapping items already on the ground.

name: CheckBaseBuildingPlacementMask
label: Check build placement mask
meaning: Whether the normal base-building placement checks apply.

name: UseNoTouchBox
label: Use no-touch box
meaning: Whether a keep-out box stops things being placed through it.

name: BoxOverlapFlags
label: Overlap flags
meaning: A bitmask of what this recipe ignores when checking overlaps (BuildAnywhere sets it to 0).

name: MaxInstancesPerFlagArea
label: Max instances per flag area
meaning: How many of the finished object may exist in one flag area. Tested in game.
